title: Rollout explainability & cost-tradeoff flyouts for Private/VPC console
creator: Eva Morales
description: Design, prototype, and validate an in-context flyout that explains rollout choices for private/VPC deployments. The flyout should surface: rollout safety signals, cost delta estimates across model variants and batch/quantization configurations, suggested rollback triggers, and the minimal set of actions a tenant admin needs to approve to move from canary to full rollout. Goal is to reduce ambiguity for operators during upgrades and to make cost vs. reliability tradeoffs explicit in the Console's rollout flow.
acceptance_criteria: Flyout prototype exists in Figma and is linked in this ticket
Edge cases documented: cross-region rollouts, mixed-capacity tenants, and emergency rollback paths
Engineering review recorded with at least two runtime-specific constraints (KV cache warming, batch latency impact)
PM sign-off that presented cost deltas align with Redwood Optimize rough estimates
Usability test with 5 platform engineers or tenant admins showing >80% first-click success on identifying recommended action
comments: 2025-01-15 - PM (R. Singh): Love the 'estimated token cost delta' panel — please surface assumptions (seq length, qps, quantization level).
2025-01-20 - Eng (M. Chen): Need to ensure we don't promise realtime cost calc — propose showing sampled estimates with a tooltip explaining staleness.
2025-01-24 - Design review (A. Khatri): Updated visual to collapse low-impact metrics into a single summary row to reduce cognitive load.
2025-01-28 - Security (L. Novak): Confirm that rollback recommendations don't expose internal cluster ids; recommend tenant-scoped labels only.
2025-02-02 - Jonah Park: Incorporated engineering feedback; added 'confidence band' visual for cost estimate and a link-to-eval that surfaces recent perf regressions.
2025-02-03 - Eva Morales: Ready for final usability pass; uploaded clickable prototype and test script.
decisions: Show sampled cost estimates (90th/10th percentile) instead of exact realtime pricing to avoid expensive queries
Expose three action buttons: Promote, Pause & Inspect, and Revert to Previous; map Promote -> canary->90% rollout policy
Group low-impact telemetry into single 'examples' row to prevent alert fatigue
Do not auto-trigger rollback; flyout recommends triggers but requires explicit operator approval

Engineering: instrument rollout service to emit sampled cost delta metrics - spike PR 2w
PM: align UX copy with billing team glossary of terms and add tooltip copy to Confluence
